card.capacity_status_quote: All of our operational capacity is fully contracted. We are contracting substantial portions of capacity before it even arrives.
card.demand_direction_quote: We see strong demand across the board, both on inference and training, and that continues to drive demand and elongate life cycles for those older generations of equipment.
card.guidance_direction_quote: We increased ARR under contract to $3.1 billion, remain on track to hit $3.7 billion exiting calendar 2026
card.constraint_owner_quote: We are not chasing demand; we are racing to build supply fast enough to meet it.
